name: achiri-safety skill — pre-flight content safety filter (T3 Skills)
goal: Implement agents/achiri/safety-filter.ts — a pattern-based pre-flight safety check that rejects harmful messages before the LLM call. Wire into AchiriConversationHandler.chat(). This is the first of 6 T3 skills (achiri-safety). Required before public alpha launch per Summer Yu rule: safety must be in code, not chat-only.
rationale: Achiri is a public-facing product. Before any alpha user can reach it (Apr 25), a safety layer must exist. Pattern-based filter is cost-free ($0.00 — no LLM call for rejected messages) and deterministic. Handles: self-harm, explicit violence, explicit sexual content, spam/abuse patterns.
swarm: NOT USED — new file + surgical edit. Direct write is faster and safer for safety-critical code.

tasks.title: agents/achiri/safety-filter.ts — pattern safety filter
tasks.description: Export safetyCheck(message: string): SafetyResult. SafetyResult = { safe: boolean; category?: string; reply?: string }. Categories: self_harm, violence, explicit_sexual, spam_abuse. Patterns are regex arrays per category. If matched, return safe=false with a Darija-first refusal message. If safe, return { safe: true }. Add ACHIRI_SKIP_SAFETY=1 env var for tests. Register in T3 skills manifest.

tasks.title: agents/achiri/index.ts — wire safety check before LLM call
tasks.description: In chat(), after daily limit check and before LLM call: call safetyCheck(userMessage). If !safe, return reply (the Darija refusal). Log [Achiri] safety_block category=X userId=Y. Do NOT increment daily counter for blocked messages (they cost nothing). Bypass with ACHIRI_SKIP_SAFETY=1.

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-safety-filter.ts — 6-check validation
tasks.description: Tests: (1) normal message passes, (2) self_harm pattern blocked, (3) violence pattern blocked, (4) explicit_sexual blocked, (5) spam_abuse blocked, (6) ACHIRI_SKIP_SAFETY=1 bypasses all blocks. Check that blocked messages return the Darija refusal and do NOT call LLM.
